categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extent of land, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land ownership and property rights rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories. The document is explicitly published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette, confirming its land-related nature.
